source_pages: printed p.200 / PDF 202 (codes), with the system pages p.196-199 / PDF 198-201 read for what the modules are
system_note: Hide & Seek (printed p.195-203): 'a system that houses cabinets inside it, creating an accessible and accessorised cupboard unit', SMALL (A + I) and LARGE (A + I + A), LH or RH. Module heights are the tall heights - 198 / 210 / 222 / 234 - and 'to calculate the right height from the floor of the module always add the height of the plinth (H. 1, H. 6 cm or H. 10 cm)'. If base or tall units stand next to an A module, 'always add a 2.5 cm wide spacer-filler' (p.198). NOT available in Natural Stone, Engineered Stone, Ceramics, Glass, Metals, glass doors, Groove, Shaker doors and Lacquered Intarsio (p.196). Whether a top element may stand on it is not printed.
extraction_note: 2026-10-04, group 1 of the catalog recon (Andriy: generate what can be generated with confidence): the H.198 twin of printed p.202 - 17 codes in 5 types, ALL held for lookup and none buildable, for the reason hide_seek_h222.json gives. Codes zipped against the H.222 page position by position, widths checked by script. The visible side panel rows are priced without codes and not held.

data.plinth_note: The page offers 1, 6 or 10 cm. 100 is the tall chapter default and is a placeholder: every type here is held for lookup and not buildable, so nothing draws it. hide_seek_h222.json chose 60 for the 7612 run it joins.

hs_module_accessory.description: Hide & Seek accessory module (A1) - the inside can be fitted with base units, shelves and/or tall units
hs_module_accessory.not_buildable_reason: HELD FOR LOOKUP. A Hide & Seek module is a shell, not a box with a front: the system is a walk-in cupboard assembled from modules A and I with one door hung on A (printed p.196-198). No front_layout kind or shape draws it yet, and an envelope would draw a closed cabinet where the page draws a room.
hs_module_accessory.wall_hung_note: NOT OFFERED: no wall-hung margin line and no depth-band glyph on printed p.200 (read on a 130-dpi render 2026-09-28); the system is floor-standing by its own drawings (printed p.196-198).
hs_module_accessory.notes: 'An empty tall unit that can be fitted with base units, shelves and/or tall units' (printed p.199): d.64,5 takes units W.60, d.69,5 takes units W.60 + 2 x 2,5 cm fillers. A 'Visible side panel for accessorised module' is priced beside it WITHOUT A CODE (printed p.200) - not held. Ski-B LED in the top panel or Mininoor in the side panel is possible (p.199).

hs_door.description: Hide & Seek door for module H 198 - W.75, with interior door straightener, opened by a handle
hs_door.not_buildable_reason: HELD FOR LOOKUP. The door hangs on module A and covers the hallway I (printed p.196, p.198); it is drawn with the system, not alone.
hs_door.wall_hung_note: NOT OFFERED: no wall-hung margin line and no depth-band glyph on printed p.200 (read on a 130-dpi render 2026-09-28); the system is floor-standing by its own drawings (printed p.196-198).
hs_door.notes: Printed p.196: 'Access to the cupboard ... is gained by means of a door provided with an interior door straightener ... It is opened by means of a handle.' Available in all Cesar door finishes except those for framed doors and for steel. 7612 (Andriy, 2026-09-28): push to open inward, spring shut flush - not what the page prints; an Elda question. W.75 is the only door width at every height.
